17.say: Check that. Can a mushroom make its own food from sunlight? How does it get food?
hit: mushrooms can make their own food from sunlight
miss: Mushrooms are heterotrophs. They cannot make their own food from sunlight, so they absorb food from dead matter.
mushrooms do not make their own food so they absorb it
algae make their own food but mushrooms don't

19.say: Check that. Glycolysis and the Krebs cycle are stages of cellular respiration. What are the two parts of photosynthesis?
hit: the two parts are glycolysis and the krebs cycle
part 1 is glycolysis and part 2 is the krebs cycle
miss: Part 1 is the light-dependent reactions. Part 2 is the light-independent reactions, also called the Calvin cycle.
the calvin cycle is part 2, not the krebs cycle
part 2 is the calvin cycle which is not part of cellular respiration like glycolysis

31.say: Check that. Fermentation only keeps glycolysis going. How many ATP per glucose does the cell get?
hit: fermentation gives the cell about 32 atp
miss: When oxygen is missing, fermentation turns NADH back into NAD+. That gives NAD+ back to glycolysis so it can keep making 2 ATP per glucose.
fermentation makes 2 atp, but with oxygen the cell makes 36
fermentation lets glycolysis make 4 atp total and 2 net

33.say: Check that. Count again. Pyruvic acid has 3 carbons. How many does ethyl alcohol have?
hit: ethyl alcohol has more carbons than pyruvic acid
pyruvic acid has fewer carbons than alcohol
miss: Pyruvic acid has 3 carbons, but ethyl alcohol has only 2. One carbon leaves as carbon dioxide gas and floats away.
ethyl alcohol has fewer carbons than pyruvic acid
pyruvic acid has more carbons than alcohol
